full_judgment: 36. At the fag-end of the hearing, the learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits that, under illustrations (g) of section 114 of the Evidence Act, the presumption of alleged participation of the plaintiff in measuring the suit land and to hand over possession of the same in favour of the defendant No. 1 goes against the plaintiff as no bainapatra dated 19-1-2008 let alone any sketch map thereof has been produced. But from the written statement filed by the defendant No. 1, we don't find that the defendant No. 1 ever claimed to execute any bainapatra in black and white let alone drawn any sketch map rather what he stated in the written statement that "অত্র মোকদ্দমার ২নং কবলা দাতা বিবাদী ও ১নং কবলা গ্রহীতা বিবাদী ১৯-১-২০০৮ তারিখ চুক্তিবদ্ধ হন ". So, from the above assertion, the provision of the Evidence Act as relied upon by the learned counsel clearly falls through.
